references.text: Eliab, son of Helon, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun at the census.
Eliab, son of Helon, brought his offering as the prince of the children of Zebulun at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Eliab, son of Helon, led the army of the tribe of Zebulun when Israel broke camp from Sinai.
The tribe of Zebulun descends from Zebulun, Jacob's sixth son with Leah.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun, which prophesied about the tribe's future dwelling place.
